text: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(p.product_type) = 'beverage' THEN oi.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS beverage_revenue FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE LOWER(c.customer_name) = 'ryan byrd' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
